recipe.label: Watercolor Wash

traits.medium: transparent watercolor landscape with loose layered pigment washes
traits.texture: visible cold-pressed paper, delicate pigment blooms and feathered wash edges
traits.composition: keep the low horizon and broad cloud bands; leave small light areas as unpainted paper
traits.lighting: luminous warm sunset washes against cool island silhouettes

review_checks: paper is visibly part of the image
translucent washes instead of opaque impasto
limitations: Paper and pigment behavior are visual approximations, not a physical watercolor simulation.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style reference; intended use: One reviewed Watercolor Wash example for the Art Skill style catalog
Primary request: A wide view across dark gently rippling water toward low island silhouettes beneath an expansive sunset sky. The horizon sits low, with a larger dark headland at the left edge, layered orange, coral, gold and purple clouds and a tiny distant boat near the right horizon.
Style/medium: transparent watercolor landscape with loose layered pigment washes
Color palette: #F7F0DF, #DF9269, #CC6573, #706C96, #3C5768
Materials/textures: visible cold-pressed paper, delicate pigment blooms and feathered wash edges
Composition/framing: keep the low horizon and broad cloud bands; leave small light areas as unpainted paper; Keep landscape orientation and the original broad framing; one image, no frame or panels
Lighting/mood: luminous warm sunset washes against cool island silhouettes
Requested output target: 1536x1024, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: real people; copyrighted characters; logos and brand marks; copied artworks; unrequested lettering
Constraints: Keep the original low horizon, open water, dark left headland, low islands and sweeping layered sunset clouds. The sky dominates. Do not add a garden, terrace, trees or a towering central cloud.; No added people, brands, characters, captions or signatures; Use only this source photograph as the composition reference; never mix motifs from the other photos
